description: This PHP class 'Generate' extends 'DauxCommand' and is part of the console commands for the Daux documentation generator. It provides functionality to configure and execute the 'generate' command, which creates documentation in various formats like HTML or Confluence, with options for deleting pages and printing diffs.

classes.name: Generate
classes.description: A command class for generating documentation with various options, integrating with Symfony Console components and the Daux documentation generator.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, and options like format, delete, printDiffAndExit, and destination.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Prepares the configuration builder based on input options for the generation process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the execution of the generate command, including parsing arguments, building configuration, instantiating Daux, and triggering documentation generation.
